addr: 114, 8th Cross Rd, behind Sri kanika parameshwari temple, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003, India

rev.t: Best part of this marriage hall is it's right in the middle of Malleswaram and people don't worry there is pay and park facility in basement for this. Marriage hall is good enough and there is lift as well for elderly also. Overall good. It's good for small to medium size gathering

This place seems to be compact for smaller functions not suitable for a large marriage gathering. Located on a elevated place with only one aged lift system it's not senior citizen friendly. Parking is another issue due to narrow roads. Dining at basement is another problem. Better to check the place before booking for all aspects.

Nice place for functions. Enough space for parking, the function hall is spacious. I think it can accommodate around 250 to 300 people at once. Toilets well maintained. Got a separate dining hall. Got to know that it has around 10 Spacious rooms in addition to two rooms for the bride and the groom (attached to the stage).
